title: Lost Property
narration: A suitcase containing my clothes arrived at airport lost property before I lost it. It held bloodstained clothes, cash and tomorrow's boarding pass. A recorder exposed my manager's smuggling and his plan to frame me, so police arrested him. When officers reopened the case, the money had vanished. My colleague thanked me for removing him and displayed tomorrow's boarding pass. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. It carried my name but her photograph; I had helped her steal the operation.
